rules.title: Jobs are failing
rules.description: Jobs of one kind that ended failed in the last 15 minutes. A failed job did not reach its goal after its retries.

rules.title: Jobs are waiting too long
rules.description: How long the oldest job that could run has waited. Long waits mean no worker is claiming jobs, or workers are busy.

rules.title: Running jobs lost their worker
rules.description: Running jobs whose worker stopped renewing the lease. Another worker takes them over; if none does, they stay stuck.

rules.title: A worker stopped reporting
rules.description: A deployment worker that did not stop cleanly and has not written its heartbeat for this long (workers write one every 15 seconds).

rules.title: Nobody holds a leader role
rules.description: A role only one worker plays (replica supervisor, outbox relay, alert evaluator) has had no holder for this long.

rules.title: The supervisor is acting often
rules.description: Replica actions (recreate, restart, substitute, retire) the supervisor took in the last hour. Many in a row usually mean one cause that keeps coming back.

rules.title: A replica is unhealthy
rules.description: An instance the supervisor rates unhealthy (its port check keeps failing).

rules.title: An application is failed or degraded
rules.description: An application whose derived status is failed (its last start, stop or restart failed) or degraded (fewer instances run than it should have).

rules.title: Incus cannot be reached
rules.description: The worker cannot read the member or instance list from Incus. Deployments, moves and recovery wait until it can.

rules.title: A cluster member is not online
rules.description: An Incus cluster member whose status is not Online. Two of three offline puts the cluster's quorum at risk.

rules.title: A failed server is waiting for fencing
rules.description: A server Incus reports Offline holds modules on shared storage that restart on another server only once it is fenced: its storage lease expired, or a person confirmed it is off. Normally about 140 s after it stopped.

rules.title: A certificate expires soon
rules.description: Days left before the certificate the worker uses to reach Incus, or the Incus server certificate it trusts, expires.

rules.title: A scheduled snapshot or backup failed
rules.description: The last scheduled snapshot or backup of a volume failed (or no backup pool is configured).

rules.title: A backup is overdue
rules.description: Age of a scheduled volume's newest backup, in schedule periods (2 means two backups were missed in a row).

rules.title: Messages are not being delivered
rules.description: How long the oldest undelivered outbox message (audit copies, alert notifications) has waited.

rules.title: Apelora's database restore is not proven
rules.description: Days since a restore of Apelora's own database was last verified by the drill. Read from the drill's record where the worker can see it (APELORA_RESTORE_DRILL_RECORD).
